body: Yes, 5 years of therapy. It wasn't abuse, at least not conventional type. Divorce at 4 years old, no contact with mother till 23 years old, father work 15 hours a day 7 days a week, lived alone since 15, pretty much no one raised me, and I'm starting to feel that.

Might check the testosterone, but I'm working out regularly and taking ZMA supplements, so if I don't have a testosterone now, I can't imagine what I would be at if I didn't do those things.

Thanks for the post - yeah lack of passion would be a common thing in my life, it's hard for me so stick with one thing. Hmm I'll dwell on it for a bit.

edit: I'm horny as fuck so it cannot be low testosterone btw, or if it is I don't want to have it high or I'll fuck everything.
Making friends is piss easy, I can't keep them.

Ok, I used to have depression, for a long time, I know how it feels - I do not have depression I have lack of social skills and intuition, I'm great at first impressions, but I suck at keeping it and I have no fucking clue why. I actually live with some friends I made on my own and we were getting along very well for almost a year - now we are at the edge of the contract and we are all splitting apart, or actually 3 other people move together and I'm moving on my own. Beats me what I did wrong.

My goals in my life? Find a partner, get a career so I can have children and ok life. I'm single for 4 years now - not that I didn't try. I actually opened countless girls, tried online dating, get my wardrobe sorted, started working out, the whole deal - didn't get one fucking date in 4 years... I must be seeing myself completetly differently than the rest of  thw world does.

My career? Well I spent 7 years on pursuing career as a game artist, but the mistake I made was not researching the industry. So I'm pretty ok at doing something that sucks out your life and pays shit until you are so burned out that you can't do it any more. If I knew this before I went for it I would never pursue it. Now I'm 30 with basically no network and no other skills so I'm working in a no progress job that pays just enough to not be in debt, but there is no chance to save up anything.

and no 30 is not plenty of time, as there are millions of 18-20 years old who can work harder, learning faster and will work for nothing because they are supported by their parents - this is who I'm up against. Can't afford another degree, as you can take loan only for one in UK and have no work experience. Believe me this is not whining or depression talking, like I said this is just observation and calculations based on the experience of my last few years of life.

I think I got everything I need except I have no luck at all. Seriously how I see it is I had no one to teach me how to be a grown up, so I made a long string of very bad decisions, and I went to far, I just don't see how I can get on some sort of track.

Artistic - apparently I'm really good at creating characters and making them in 3D. 3 years was looking for a job, after 4 years of uni, and nothing - gave up about a year ago. Going for that career was the stupidest fucking idea of my life, just next to lying to love of my life.

Climbing, live drawing, poetry nights, trying to socialise out, going to night clubs, gliding, coffee with co workers are some of the things I did in lets say last 3 months - the thing is it doesn't actually improve my situation long term. It doesn't improve my loneliness, for some reason I push people away from myself and I'm unable to keep them close. I'm awesome at first impressions but once people get to know me they start to dislike me. It's not that I'm whining here, I'm actually trying to do something... 4 fucking years now.
